Name: Lumisteria DGA Furnitures
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
This page lists the DGA conversions of mods made originally for CF.

Currently includes :
- Lumisteria DGA Pride Banners 1.0.0 (Also includes : One new banner (Hollyhock banner) and french translation.)
- Lumisteria DGA Flowers and Plant Set 1.0.0 (Also includes : french translation)
- Lumisteria DGA Spring Set 1.0.0
Those conversions were made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/120958053]Elizabeth[/url], thanks !
- Lumisteria DGA Oak Set 1.0.0
- Lumisteria DGA Walnut Set 1.0.0
Those conversions were made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3490737]CyanFire[/url], thanks !
- Lumisteria DGA Beech Set 1.0.0
This conversion was done by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url], thanks !

The oak set is sold at monday at Robin, the walnut set is sold at tuesday at Robin, the beech set is sold at thursday at Robin, they are available in the catalog too.
